item.fallenroses.sukuna_finger.desc: For the Vessel: permanently raises cursed energy and awakens Dismantle, Cleave and the domain.
item.fallenroses.special_grade_seal.desc: Use on the ground to break the seal. A special grade curse is sealed inside.
item.fallenroses.playful_cloud.desc: A three-section staff with no technique of its own — pure force. Hits spend 3 CE to strike harder.
item.fallenroses.inverted_spear_of_heave: Strips beneficial effects from the target. Deals x1.5 damage to curses.
item.fallenroses.split_soul_katana.desc: Cuts the soul, not the body: for 2 CE part of the damage ignores armor.
item.fallenroses.slaughter_demon.desc: A grade 4 short blade. Wounds curses even without cursed energy.
tooltip.fallenroses.cursed_tool: Cursed tool: curses take full damage
tooltip.fallenroses.scroll: Sorcerer or Cursed Spirit, depending on the technique. Sneak to replace your own.
class.fallenroses.sorcerer.desc: Wields cursed energy. The innate technique is rolled from the sorcerer pool: Limitless, Projection, Ten Shadows, Lightning, Idle Death Gamble, Star Rage, Ishigori's Energy Discharge and more.
class.fallenroses.heavenly_restriction.d: A body without a drop of cursed energy — and therefore perfect. Hurts curses with any weapon, fights on stamina.
class.fallenroses.vessel.desc: Yuji Itadori from the manga's final arc. Sukuna's fingers awaken Dismantle and Cleave, Death Paintings awaken the Blood Spear. His own Black Flash and domain.
stat.fallenroses.control.desc: Technique power (+4% per point) and energy regeneration.
stat.fallenroses.control.stamina.desc: Ability power (+4% per point) and stamina regeneration.
technique.fallenroses.limitless.desc: Mastery of infinity: Blue attracts, Red repels, together they make Hollow Purple.
technique.fallenroses.shrine.desc: The King of Curses' technique: unseen cuts, cleaving, spiderweb and the flame of Fuga.
technique.fallenroses.cursed_speech.desc: Every word is an order that cannot be disobeyed. The price is your own throat.
technique.fallenroses.boogie_woogie.desc: One clap and two swap places. A simple technique, terrifying in skilled hands.
technique.fallenroses.heavenly_body.desc: Not a technique but the peak of the human body: dashes, crushing blows and a hunter's instinct.
ability.fallenroses.blue.desc: A point of attraction: pulls everything in and grinds it at the center.
ability.fallenroses.red.desc: A repulsion orb from your fingertips: the blast throws enemies away.
ability.fallenroses.hollow_purple.desc: Blue and Red merge into a sphere that erases everything in its path.
ability.fallenroses.infinity.desc: Attacks and projectiles stop before reaching you. Drains energy while active.
ability.fallenroses.unlimited_void.desc: Everyone inside drowns in infinite information — unable to move or strike.
ability.fallenroses.dismantle.desc: A nearly invisible cut flies forward, slicing everyone in its path.
ability.fallenroses.cleave.desc: A lattice of cuts on the target, scaling with its toughness.
ability.fallenroses.spiderweb.desc: Your palm touches the ground and cuts spread out in every direction.
ability.fallenroses.fuga.desc: "Open": a fire arrow that leaves everything around burning.
ability.fallenroses.malevolent_shrine.de: A domain without a barrier: everything alive inside is cut nonstop.
ability.fallenroses.dont_move.desc: Binds everyone in front of you.
ability.fallenroses.blast_away.desc: Blows away enemies in front of you.
ability.fallenroses.twist.desc: Twists the target from inside: heavy damage and weakness.
ability.fallenroses.explode.desc: The target explodes, hitting everyone nearby. Badly hurts your throat.
ability.fallenroses.vanish.desc: The ultimate order: huge damage to everyone around, costs 40% of your health.
ability.fallenroses.feint.desc: Enemies around get confused and attack each other.
ability.fallenroses.clap_barrage.desc: Hop from enemy to enemy, wounding each one.
ability.fallenroses.brother_strike.desc: Swap behind the enemy; your next hit becomes a Black Flash.
ability.fallenroses.chaos_clap.desc: All enemies around swap places at random, hurting and confusing each other.
ability.fallenroses.dash.desc: A lightning dash forward that knocks down everything in the way.
ability.fallenroses.ground_slam.desc: Leap and smash the ground: the shockwave launches enemies.
ability.fallenroses.flurry.desc: Eight hits in a second, the last one knocks back.
ability.fallenroses.killer_instinct.desc: See everyone around through walls; faster and stronger for 10 seconds.
ability.fallenroses.berserk.desc: 15 seconds: x1.5 damage, speed, resistance, hits heal you.
message.fallenroses.no_technique: You have no innate technique. Look for scrolls and Sukuna's fingers in treasure chests.
message.fallenroses.slot_locked: This ability is locked — unlock it in the character window (K)
message.fallenroses.learned: You have learned the innate technique: %s
message.fallenroses.replace_hint: Your technique is %s. Sneak and use the scroll to replace it.
message.fallenroses.scroll_hr: Your body has no cursed energy — the scroll is useless
message.fallenroses.finger: Sukuna's finger consumed (%s/%s). Maximum cursed energy: %s
message.fallenroses.finger_limit: Your body cannot take another finger
message.fallenroses.reinforce_empty: Your cursed energy has run dry
message.fallenroses.controls_hint: X / C — abilities, Shift+X / Shift+C — unlockable abilities, Shift+V — domain, V — reinforcement, K — character. Rebind in Controls.
message.fallenroses.strike_ready: Your next hit is a Black Flash!
message.fallenroses.seal_broken: The seal is broken... The ground trembles.
command.fallenroses.info: %s, lv. %s (%s/%s xp), energy %s/%s, technique: %s, talent points: %s (spent %s)
death.attack.fallenroses.cursed_techniqu: %1$s fell to the cursed technique of %2$s
%1$s fell to the cursed technique of %2$s using %3$s
%1$s fell to a cursed technique while fighting %2$s
intro.fallenroses.title: JJK! Fallen Roses
intro.fallenroses.line2: Every day people fear, hate and lose hope. Those feelings never truly vanish.
intro.fallenroses.line3: They gather in the dark — and give birth to curses.
intro.fallenroses.line4: Ordinary people cannot see them. But you can.
intro.fallenroses.line5: The black roses have already bloomed. Choose who you will become.
intro.fallenroses.choose_path_hint: Hover a card, click it and confirm. You cannot change it later.
advancements.fallenroses.root.title: JJK! Fallen Roses
advancements.fallenroses.root.descriptio: The world of curses has opened to you
advancements.fallenroses.chose_class.des: Choose a class at the start
advancements.fallenroses.grade_2.title: Grade 2
advancements.fallenroses.grade_2.descrip: Exorcise a grade 2 curse: Many Hands or the Hanged One
advancements.fallenroses.level_5.title: Grade 4 Sorcerer
advancements.fallenroses.level_10.title: Grade 3 Sorcerer
advancements.fallenroses.level_20.title: Grade 2 Sorcerer
advancements.fallenroses.level_30.title: Grade 1 Sorcerer
advancements.fallenroses.level_50.title: The Strongest
advancements.fallenroses.new_technique.d: Learn a technique from a scroll
advancements.fallenroses.black_flash.des: Strike within a millionth of a second
talent.fallenroses.core.desc: The heart of your soul. Three branches grow from it: Body, Technique and Energy. You gain talent points every level.
talent.fallenroses.divergent_fist.desc: While reinforced, a second wave of energy follows every punch (40% damage).
talent.fallenroses.reinforce_mastery.des: Reinforcement drains 40% less energy and grants another +15% damage.
talent.fallenroses.momentum.desc: On kill: Speed II for 3 seconds and +5% resource.
talent.fallenroses.body_peak.desc: Branch capstone. +15% melee damage and +4 health.
talent.fallenroses.ability_3.desc: Unlocks the third ability. Requires level 18 and Depth and Resonance maxed.
talent.fallenroses.ability_4.desc: Unlocks the fourth ability. Requires level 28 and Expansion and Technique Endurance maxed.
talent.fallenroses.ultimate.desc: Unlocks the technique's maximum form. Requires level 40 and Heart of Technique and Seal maxed.
talent.fallenroses.tech_peak.desc: Branch capstone. +10% ability power, supreme form cooldown 25% shorter.
talent.fallenroses.energy.desc: Maximum cursed energy (stamina for Heavenly Restriction).
talent.fallenroses.flow.desc: +0.5% energy regeneration per second per rank (stamina: +1%).
talent.fallenroses.black_flash.desc: +5% Black Flash chance on reinforced hits.
talent.fallenroses.reverse_technique.des: While reinforced, wounds heal using cursed energy.
talent.fallenroses.senses.desc: 12% chance to fully dodge a hit or projectile.
talent.fallenroses.recovery.desc: Restores half a heart every 2 seconds.
talent.fallenroses.energy_peak.desc: Branch capstone. +25% maximum cursed energy or stamina.
screen.fallenroses.tree_hint: LMB — learn · wheel — zoom · drag — pan · space — to core · Shift+LMB on core — reset
screen.fallenroses.need_parent: Learn a connected talent below first
screen.fallenroses.reset_hint: Shift + LMB - refund all spent talent points. Free.
class.fallenroses.cursed_spirit.desc: A body of cursed energy: wounds close by themselves, wild curses treat you as kin. The disaster is random: flames, transfiguration, plants, tides, smallpox, rot, swarm or Rika.
class.fallenroses.curse_manipulator.desc: Absorbs exorcised spirits and summons them to fight. Uzumaki burns them all at once.
technique.fallenroses.blood_manipulation: The Kamo clan art: compressed blood fires as beams, slices as discs and bursts as orbs. Every move costs a little of your own blood.
technique.fallenroses.ratio.desc: Any target can be split by a 7:3 line, and a strike there is critical. After work hours, overtime begins.
technique.fallenroses.straw_doll.desc: Hammer and nails. Nails stay in bodies, and Resonance strikes everyone who carries them.
technique.fallenroses.disaster_flames.de: A volcano spirit: ember insects, eruptions, a falling meteor and the Coffin of the Iron Mountain.
technique.fallenroses.idle_transfigurati: A touch reshapes the soul, and the body follows. Weakened foes transfigure instantly.
technique.fallenroses.disaster_plants.de: A forest spirit: life-draining buds, roots, a flower field and the Ceremonial Sea of Light.
technique.fallenroses.curse_manipulation: Exorcised spirits shrink into black orbs and are swallowed, to be released later to fight for you.
ability.fallenroses.piercing_blood.desc: Compressed blood fires as a 32-block beam through everyone in line.
ability.fallenroses.slicing_exorcism.des: Two spinning blood discs arc outward and cut through everything.
ability.fallenroses.flowing_red_scale.de: Blood flows faster: 15 s of strength, speed, haste and +15% ability power.
ability.fallenroses.supernova.desc: Six blood orbs circle you, then rush enemies and explode.
ability.fallenroses.blood_rain.desc: A crimson cloud gathers over the target and rains blood spikes for 5 seconds.
ability.fallenroses.ratio_strike.desc: Dash to the target and hit the 7:3 point for double critical damage.
ability.fallenroses.blunt_combo.desc: Four heavy blows with the wrapped blade; the last one knocks back.
ability.fallenroses.collapse.desc: Strike the ground: a rift runs forward and launches every enemy.
ability.fallenroses.overtime.desc: Work hours are over: 20 s of ×1.3 ability power, strength and resistance.
ability.fallenroses.fatal_ratio.desc: Dozens of 7:3 lines bind the target, and one strike passes through all of them.
ability.fallenroses.nails.desc: Three nails hammered mid-flight. Nails that hit stay in the body.
ability.fallenroses.resonance.desc: A nail into the straw doll damages everyone carrying nails, per nail.
ability.fallenroses.hairpin.desc: Every nail stuck in nearby bodies explodes at once.
ability.fallenroses.nail_storm.desc: Ten nails in one second: a barrage of hammer strikes.
ability.fallenroses.black_resonance.desc: Resonance in a Black Flash: huge damage to everyone nailed and everyone nearby.
ability.fallenroses.ember_insects.desc: Three smouldering bugs seek out enemies and burst into flame.
ability.fallenroses.flame_breath.desc: A cone of fire pours from your mouth for a second and a half.
ability.fallenroses.fire_pillar.desc: The ground under the target cracks, then a pillar of fire erupts.
ability.fallenroses.maximum_meteor.desc: A burning boulder falls from the sky where you aim.
ability.fallenroses.coffin_of_iron_mount: Domain Expansion: Coffin of the Iron Mountain
Everyone inside stands in a volcano's throat: the fire never dies and lava erupts from the ground.
ability.fallenroses.soul_touch.desc: A palm on the target. Weakened foes transfigure instantly; others take armor-piercing damage.
ability.fallenroses.body_repel.desc: Your arm swells into a giant club and sweeps everything ahead.
ability.fallenroses.spike_burst.desc: Your body bristles with bone spikes for a moment.
ability.fallenroses.soul_multiplicity.de: Three transfigured humans crawl out and fight for 40 seconds.
ability.fallenroses.self_embodiment.desc: Every soul inside is within reach. Weakened foes transfigure without a chance.
ability.fallenroses.cursed_buds.desc: Buds sprout in enemies ahead and drain them; you heal for each target.
ability.fallenroses.root_eruption.desc: Four waves of roots in a line: damage and paralysis.
ability.fallenroses.flower_field.desc: Cursed flowers bloom at your feet for 8 s: enemies weaken, you heal.
ability.fallenroses.wooden_balls.desc: Three heavy balls of cursed wood roll forward and flatten everything.
ability.fallenroses.sea_of_light.desc: Light gathered by the flower on your arm erupts as a huge beam.
ability.fallenroses.absorb.desc: A weakened spirit (below 40% health) shrinks into an orb and is swallowed: +2 charges.
ability.fallenroses.release_spirits.desc: Three Fly Heads and a Rotten Mouth serve for 45 s. Costs 3 charges.
ability.fallenroses.curse_swarm.desc: Six black spirit orbs scatter and hunt down enemies.
ability.fallenroses.summon_grade_two.des: The Hand Spider and the Hanged serve for a minute. Costs 5 charges.
ability.fallenroses.uzumaki.desc: Every absorbed spirit compresses into a black vortex beam. Damage grows with charges (minimum 5).
talent.fallenroses.ability_2.desc: Unlocks the second ability. Requires level 8 and Technique Power maxed.
talent.fallenroses.spirit_body.desc: Wounds close twice as fast and cheaper; +4 health.
talent.fallenroses.curse_bond.desc: The Manipulator can hold 6 more spirits.
talent.fallenroses.toughness.desc: +1 armor and +5% knockback resistance per rank.
talent.fallenroses.last_stand.desc: Below 30% health: +25% melee damage and -20% damage taken.
talent.fallenroses.ult_mastery.desc: The supreme form is 25% stronger and 20% cheaper.
talent.fallenroses.tech_chain.desc: Each ability shortens the other cooldowns by 1 second per rank.
talent.fallenroses.veil.desc: While reinforced, damage taken is 15% lower.
talent.fallenroses.deep_reserve.desc: +5% maximum cursed energy or stamina per rank.
message.fallenroses.finger_not_vessel: Sukuna's finger is deadly poison. Only the Vessel can absorb it
message.fallenroses.finger_awakens: The Vessel awakens: ability "%s" unlocked (a tree talent is still needed)
message.fallenroses.slot_fingers: This ability still sleeps: fingers eaten %s of %s
message.fallenroses.scroll_not_sorcerer: Only sorcerers can read scrolls; your power is of another nature
message.fallenroses.absorb_no_curse: Look at a curse (not special grade)
message.fallenroses.absorb_too_strong: The spirit is still strong; weaken it below 40% health
item.fallenroses.dragon_bone.desc: Stores the force of hits: every 5th hit releases it as a jet blast.
item.fallenroses.kamutoke.desc: Every 3rd hit calls lightning. Right-click: strike the target with lightning.
item.fallenroses.nanami_cleaver.desc: A wrapped blunt blade: 30% of hits land on the 7:3 point (×1.6).
technique.fallenroses.ten_shadows.desc: The Zenin clan technique: hand signs call shikigami out of your own shadow — dogs, a toad, Nue, an elephant and Mahoraga.
technique.fallenroses.projection.desc: Naoya Zenin: one second split into 24 frames. Every move accelerates you; at the fifth stage you break the sound barrier. Whoever you touch freezes in a frame. The maximum is Time Cell Moon Palace.
technique.fallenroses.ice_formation.desc: Ice at will: shards, frost breath, an ice wall, an ice coffin and the Glacial Slope.
technique.fallenroses.disaster_tides.des: A sea spirit: fish shikigami, a tidal wave, a whirlpool, a rain of sharks and the Horizon of the Captivating Skandha.
technique.fallenroses.smallpox.desc: A spirit of pestilence: pox clouds, falling gravestones, a coffin with three bell tolls, plague and the Cemetery.
ability.fallenroses.divine_dogs.desc: Two shikigami dogs leap out of the shadow and maul your enemies for 40 seconds.
ability.fallenroses.toad.desc: The toad's tongue grabs a target and drags it to you, briefly binding it.
ability.fallenroses.nue.desc: A winged shikigami circles your enemies for 30 seconds and dives with lightning.
ability.fallenroses.max_elephant.desc: An elephant drops out of a shadow above the target and unleashes a flood: damage, knockback, slowness.
ability.fallenroses.mahoraga: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga
ability.fallenroses.mahoraga.desc: The strongest shikigami for 45 seconds. Its wheel adapts it to any damage; the Sword of Extermination hits an area.
ability.fallenroses.frame_dash.desc: The movement is drawn in advance and played frame by frame. Those hit freeze in a frame. At acceleration stage 5 it becomes a sonic-boom dash.
ability.fallenroses.freeze_frame.desc: Whoever you touch must follow 24 frames — they fail and freeze as a panel for 2.5 s. Hits on a frozen target deal 1.5×.
ability.fallenroses.frame_barrage.desc: Six pre-drawn spots around the target, a strike from each. Double damage on a frozen target.
ability.fallenroses.acceleration.desc: Three acceleration stages at once, speed and jump for 10 s. Every Projection move adds a stage too.
ability.fallenroses.mach_strike.desc: A second of acceleration, then a 22-block dash with a sonic boom along the whole line.
ability.fallenroses.ice_shards.desc: A fan of five crystals: damage and frostbite.
ability.fallenroses.frost_calm.desc: A cone of freezing mist: damage, heavy slowness, enemies freeze over.
ability.fallenroses.ice_fall.desc: Seven ice spikes erupt along the ground ahead, tossing enemies up.
ability.fallenroses.frozen_coffin.desc: The target is frozen in a block of ice for 3 s, then it shatters for heavy damage.
ability.fallenroses.glacial_slope.desc: The ground in a 14-block radius heaves up as ice: everything alive freezes and takes huge damage.
ability.fallenroses.fish_swarm.desc: Six fish shikigami burst out of thin air and seek enemies.
ability.fallenroses.tidal_wave.desc: A wall of water rolls 14 blocks forward and sweeps everything away.
ability.fallenroses.whirlpool.desc: A vortex pulls enemies to its center for 3 seconds and hurts them.
ability.fallenroses.death_swarm.desc: The sky opens above the target and fish and sharks rain down.
ability.fallenroses.horizon_of_skandha.d: Domain Expansion: a tropical beach where fish shikigami find everyone.
ability.fallenroses.pox_cloud.desc: A stench lingers for 5 seconds: poison, weakness and damage to everyone inside.
ability.fallenroses.grave_marker.desc: Three stone slabs fall from the sky onto the target.
ability.fallenroses.coffin_trap.desc: A coffin closes around the target and a bell tolls three times. If it doesn't break free — huge damage.
ability.fallenroses.plague_bloom.desc: Every enemy within 12 blocks breaks out in sores: wither, weakness and damage every second.
ability.fallenroses.cemetery.desc: Domain expansion: gravestones fall on everyone trapped, the bell tolls — whoever the coffin catches takes a heavy blow.
message.fallenroses.mahoraga: With this treasure I summon... Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga!
screen.fallenroses.seal_needs: Seal: level %s and every node below maxed:
screen.fallenroses.need_parent_full: Max out every node leading to this seal
talent.fallenroses.bloodlust.desc: Each kill heals half a heart per rank.
talent.fallenroses.second_wind.desc: Once per 2 minutes a hit that drops you below a quarter health restores 30% health and grants resistance.
talent.fallenroses.titan.desc: +3 hearts and +10% melee damage. The peak of the body.
talent.fallenroses.ce_barrier.desc: While above half energy: −3% damage taken per rank.
talent.fallenroses.rct_mastery.desc: Reverse cursed technique heals 50% more per rank.
talent.fallenroses.simple_domain.desc: Damage from cursed techniques reduced by 25%.
talent.fallenroses.boundless_spring.desc: +10% max energy and 1.5× regeneration. The peak of energy.
advancements.fallenroses.slot_2.title: Second Seal
advancements.fallenroses.slot_3.title: Third Seal
advancements.fallenroses.slot_4.title: Fourth Seal
advancements.fallenroses.slot_5.title: Maximum Form
advancements.fallenroses.slot_5.descript: Break the final seal of the trunk
message.fallenroses.talents_refunded: The talent tree was rebuilt — all points refunded.
Hakari's technique: rough energy, shutter doors, pachinko balls, "Reach!" and the Jackpot — 30 seconds of infinite energy. Every hit builds fever.
technique.fallenroses.lightning.desc: Kashimo's technique: cursed energy with the properties of electricity. Hits charge targets, Discharge calls lightning on every charge, the maximum is Mythical Beast Amber.
technique.fallenroses.star_rage.desc: Yuki Tsukumo's technique: virtual mass. Mass punch, the shikigami Garuda, gravity well, star fall and Bonbaye — a black hole.
technique.fallenroses.death_painting.des: The Death Painting technique: corrosive blood inflicts Rot. Wing King, decay mark, rot mist and Decay Bloom.
ability.fallenroses.rough_energy.desc: A coarse burst of energy forward: damage and knockback in a narrow cone. Hits build fever.
ability.fallenroses.shutter_doors.desc: Pachinko shutters slide out beside the target and slam shut: heavy damage and a stun.
ability.fallenroses.pachinko_balls.desc: A spread of ten steel balls. Sometimes builds fever.
ability.fallenroses.reach.desc: Three reels spin overhead. A pair grants strength, a triple grants strength, speed and half your energy. Fever improves your luck.
ability.fallenroses.jackpot.desc: Domain expansion: the reels spin three times and the rules bind enemies. Jackpot — 30 seconds of infinite energy and self-healing, then the domain collapses.
ability.fallenroses.charge_strike.desc: A bolt into your target that jumps to two more. Every target gets a charge.
ability.fallenroses.static_field.desc: For 5 seconds a field crackles around you, zapping and charging an enemy inside every half second.
ability.fallenroses.staff_rush.desc: A lightning dash of 10 blocks: everyone in the path is shocked and charged.
ability.fallenroses.discharge.desc: Every charged enemy within 20 blocks is struck by lightning from the sky — more charges, more damage.
ability.fallenroses.mythical_beast_amber: For 20 seconds your body is pure lightning: speed, strength, jump, every hit chains lightning. Then the body breaks.
ability.fallenroses.mass_punch.desc: A fist as heavy as a truck: huge damage and knockback in a narrow cone.
ability.fallenroses.garuda.desc: A bird shikigami of star mass flies through enemies and returns.
ability.fallenroses.gravity_well.desc: For 3 seconds the aimed point pulls in everything alive, then crushes it into the ground.
ability.fallenroses.star_fall.desc: Leap high and fall with enormous mass: a shockwave on landing. No fall damage.
ability.fallenroses.bonbaye.desc: A black hole is born at the aimed point: for 6 seconds it pulls in everything within 14 blocks, then collapses in an explosion.
ability.fallenroses.rot_blood.desc: Three spits of corrosive blood. Every hit adds a stack of Rot.
ability.fallenroses.wing_king.desc: A wing of rotten blood slashes everything in front and corrodes it.
ability.fallenroses.decay_mark.desc: The target breaks out in sores: three stacks of Rot at once and weakness.
ability.fallenroses.rot_mist.desc: A poisonous cloud surrounds you for 5 seconds — damage and Rot every second.
ability.fallenroses.decay_bloom.desc: A wave of rot spreads 12 blocks, then everyone rotting within 20 blocks bursts. The deeper the Rot, the bigger the burst.
message.fallenroses.reach_triple: REACH! Triple %s! Luck is on your side!
message.fallenroses.reach_miss: A miss… but the fever grows.
message.fallenroses.jackpot_lose: No luck. Half the energy came back.
message.fallenroses.amber_end: The body could not hold the lightning…
message.fallenroses.prison_too_strong: This creature is too strong to seal
message.fallenroses.death_painting_rejec: A living body rejects the cursed womb!
item.fallenroses.chain_of_thousand_miles: Hits pull the target in. Right-click: hook an enemy from afar and drag them to you.
item.fallenroses.black_rope.desc: Unravels techniques: strips buffs, breaks reinforcement and Infinity. Right-click: a lash in a cone.
item.fallenroses.executioner_sword.desc: Appears in the Judge's hand only after a death sentence. Touching the condemned is death. Vanishes after 60 s.
item.fallenroses.prison_realm.desc: Gokumonkyo. Right-click a creature to seal it inside. Right-click again to release it.
item.fallenroses.death_painting.desc: A cursed womb. A Cursed Spirit gains the Rot technique, the Vessel gains his brothers' blood (Blood Spear, poison immunity). Poison to anyone else.
item.fallenroses.six_eyes_blindfold.desc: See cursed energy: night vision, curses highlighted, abilities 25% cheaper, faster energy regeneration.
advancements.fallenroses.prison_realm.de: Seal a creature in the Prison Realm
class.fallenroses.judge.desc: Hiromi Higuruma, a lawyer turned sorcerer. Gavel, "Objection!", evidence — and a trial in his own domain: confiscation or the Executioner's Sword.
technique.fallenroses.vessel.desc: Itadori after Sukuna left: the Shrine's imprint (Dismantle, Cleave), his brothers' blood (Blood Spear), Black Flash and his own domain — the Station.
Higuruma's technique. Gavel, objection and evidence; inside the domain the Judgeman passes a verdict: confiscation or the death penalty by the Executioner's Sword.
technique.fallenroses.granite_blast.desc: Ryu Ishigori — the sorcerer with the largest cursed energy output. Granite shots, barrage, ram, Overflow and Granite Blast — a 40-block beam.
technique.fallenroses.swarm.desc: A curse born from the fear of cockroaches: swarm, devour, molt, brood inside the victim and Infestation.
ability.fallenroses.time_cell_moon_palac: Domain expansion: inside, every movement tears the body's cells — the more you move, the more it hurts. Everyone freezes in a frame every 2 s.
ability.fallenroses.vessel_dismantle.des: The Shrine's imprint: a punch leaves a cross of invisible cuts flying forward. Needs 1 finger.
ability.fallenroses.vessel_cleave.desc: Dash and touch — a series of cuts adjusted to the target's toughness. Needs 3 fingers.
ability.fallenroses.blood_spear.desc: Brothers' blood: compressed blood fires from the palms through everyone for 30 blocks. Needs an absorbed Death Painting; each one strengthens it.
ability.fallenroses.black_flash_rush.des: Dash and two strikes — the second is a guaranteed Black Flash (×2.5, 10 s zone).
ability.fallenroses.vessel_domain.desc: Itadori's domain — a station platform at sunset. Strikes hit the soul: armor doesn't help, buffs fall off, Black Flash almost certain. Needs 10 fingers.
ability.fallenroses.gavel_strike.desc: The gavel grows in your hand — a heavy blow to everyone in front.
ability.fallenroses.gavel_throw.desc: A huge gavel flies at the target and stuns it.
ability.fallenroses.objection.desc: For 3 seconds the next hit on you is cancelled; the attacker is struck by the gavel and frozen.
ability.fallenroses.evidence.desc: The target is marked for 20 s: +20% damage taken, its guilt is proven at the trial.
ability.fallenroses.deadly_sentencing_do: Domain expansion — a courtroom. The Judgeman tries one defendant: confiscation for 30 s or the death penalty — the Executioner's Sword in your hand kills the condemned with one touch.
ability.fallenroses.granite_shot.desc: A clump of cursed energy from the palm that explodes on impact.
ability.fallenroses.discharge_barrage.de: Eight shots in a spread within a second.
ability.fallenroses.output_ram.desc: Your body wrapped in energy smashes everything for 10 blocks ahead.
ability.fallenroses.overflow.desc: For 10 seconds energy regenerates by itself and abilities are a quarter stronger.
ability.fallenroses.granite_cannon.desc: A second of compression — then a monstrous beam 40 blocks long and 3 thick.
ability.fallenroses.roach_swarm.desc: A cloud of cockroaches covers the cone in front: damage, blindness, hunger.
ability.fallenroses.devour.desc: The swarm bites into the target; half the damage returns as health.
ability.fallenroses.molt.desc: Shed the old shell: all bad effects fall off, the new one absorbs damage for 15 s.
ability.fallenroses.brood.desc: Cockroaches are laid in the target and burst out after 3 s — damage and three fly heads on your side.
ability.fallenroses.infestation.desc: For 6 seconds a tornado of cockroaches rages around you: damage, blindness, fly heads are born from the swarm.
message.fallenroses.barrier_locked: The domain's barrier won't let you out
message.fallenroses.barrier_blocked: The black barrier of the domain won't let you in
message.fallenroses.trial_no_defendant: No defendant in the courtroom — the session is closed
message.fallenroses.trial_open: Judgeman: "The defendant is %s. The trial begins."
message.fallenroses.confiscated: Technique confiscated by the court (%s s)
message.fallenroses.paintings_full: Your body won't take any more Death Paintings
message.fallenroses.vessel_painting_firs: Your brothers' blood accepts you: Blood Spear awakened, poison no longer harms you (%s/9)
message.fallenroses.vessel_painting: Death Painting absorbed: your blood grows stronger (%s/9)
message.fallenroses.scroll_not_spirit: Only a Cursed Spirit can absorb a cursed spirit's technique
message.fallenroses.rebirth_hint: Sneak and use the scroll to be reborn
message.fallenroses.rebirth: The scroll burns. Your old path is over — choose a new one.
item.fallenroses.scroll_rebirth.desc: The rarest scroll. Removes your class and technique and lets you choose your path again. Level, fingers and Death Paintings stay, talents are refunded.
technique.fallenroses.construction.desc: Mai's and Yorozu's technique: matter from cursed energy. Construct bullet, iron spikes, liquid metal, insect armor and the True Sphere.
technique.fallenroses.sky_manipulation.d: Uro Takako's technique: the sky is a surface. Sky ripple, a shield that reflects projectiles, fold, slide and Thin Ice Breaker.
technique.fallenroses.rika.desc: A curse born from love: claws, grab, guard, full manifestation and the 50-block Pure Love beam.
ability.fallenroses.construct_bullet.des: A bullet made of energy — a fast, precise shot.
ability.fallenroses.iron_spikes.desc: Steel stakes erupt from the ground in a line, launching and slowing.
ability.fallenroses.liquid_metal.desc: A wave of metal covers a cone and hardens on enemies — heavy slowness.
ability.fallenroses.insect_armor.desc: Yorozu's armor for 15 s: damage resistance, attackers are hurt by spikes.
ability.fallenroses.truesphere.desc: A perfect sphere of infinite mass slowly flies forward and crushes everything within 6 blocks on contact.
ability.fallenroses.sky_ripple.desc: The sky's surface bends and sweeps away everything in a cone.
ability.fallenroses.sky_shield.desc: For 4 seconds the sky around you turns enemy projectiles back.
ability.fallenroses.sky_fold.desc: The sky under the target folds: it is launched up and slammed down.
ability.fallenroses.sky_slide.desc: The sky's surface carries you 12 blocks, hitting everyone in the path.
ability.fallenroses.thin_ice_breaker.des: The sky around shatters like glass — shards cut everything within 12 blocks.
ability.fallenroses.rika_claw.desc: A huge hand from behind you tears everything in front.
ability.fallenroses.rika_grab.desc: Rika's hand grabs the target from afar, pulls it in and slams it down.
ability.fallenroses.rika_guard.desc: Rika wraps her arms around you: for 6 seconds you take much less damage, attackers are thrown back.
ability.fallenroses.rika_manifest.desc: For 15 seconds Rika is fully here: strength, speed, her claws follow every hit.
ability.fallenroses.pure_love.desc: A second and a half of compression — then a pink-white beam 50 blocks long.
item.fallenroses.miwa_katana.desc: Right-click — "Simple Domain: Iai": a 3 s stance, anyone who enters the 3.5-block circle is cut down.
item.fallenroses.mai_revolver.desc: Right-click to fire. Six rounds, the sixth is a construct bullet of double power, then a reload.
item.fallenroses.momo_broom.desc: Hold right-click to fly where you look. Uses cursed energy.
item.fallenroses.inventory_curse.desc: The worm spirit Toji carried on his body. Right-click — 27 slots inside; everything is stored in the curse itself.
